title: Higher direct images along a morphism of sites are sheafified cohomology presheaves
statement: Let $f:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a morphism of sites given by the continuous functor $u:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (3), $f_*=u^s$, and let $R^qf_*:\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$ ($q\ge0$) be the right derived functors of the left exact functor $f_*$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], $R^qf_*\mathcal F=\mathcal H^q(f_*\mathcal I^\bullet)$ (cohomology computed in the abelian category $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$) for an injective resolution $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For $\mathcal F\in\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ and $q\ge0$ let $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}$ be the presheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal D$ with $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}(V)=H^q(u(V),\mathcal F)=H^q(\mathcal I^\bullet(u(V)))$ ($H^q$ over an object, [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2)), the restriction along $V'\to V$ being induced by the restriction maps $\mathcal I^\bullet(u(V))\to\mathcal I^\bullet(u(V'))$. Then the canonical map of presheaves $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}\to R^qf_*\mathcal F$ (sending the class of a cocycle $s\in\mathcal I^q(u(V))=(f_*\mathcal I^q)(V)$ to the section of the cohomology sheaf it defines) identifies $R^qf_*\mathcal F$ with the sheafification $(\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F})^\#$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]; in particular $R^qf_*\mathcal F=0$ if and only if $(\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F})^\#=0$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images, line 747) and its proof; used in etale-cohomology.tex Lemma Tag 09AX (line 14213: 'The Zariski sheaf R^p epsilon_* F is the sheaf associated to the presheaf U -> H^p_etale(U, F)')

proof.text: *The functor $f_*$, an injective resolution, and $R^qf_*\mathcal F$.* By [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1), (3), $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ and $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$ are abelian categories, $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ has enough injectives [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives], and $f_*=u^s$, $(f_*\mathcal G)(V)=\mathcal G(u(V))$, $(f_*\varphi)_V=\varphi_{u(V)}$, is a functor $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$. It is additive ($(f_*(\varphi+\psi))_V=\varphi_{u(V)}+\psi_{u(V)}$, and finite products of abelian sheaves are computed sectionwise) and preserves kernels: the kernel of $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$ in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ is the sectionwise kernel, and so is the kernel of $f_*\varphi$ in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$ [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact] (1), and both have sections $\ker(\varphi_{u(V)})$ over $V$. So $f_*$ is left exact additive [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Choose an injective resolution $s:\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ with $\mathcal I^q=0$ for $q<0$ [lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-injective-resolution-degree-zero] (1) [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. By definition [def-sp-left-exact-additive], $R^qf_*\mathcal F=\mathcal H^q(\mathcal K^\bullet)$, the $q$-th cohomology object in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$ of the complex $\mathcal K^\bullet=f_*\mathcal I^\bullet$; for this resolution $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}(V)=H^q(\mathcal I^\bullet(u(V)))$ by [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2).

source.place: Lemma Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images, line 747), proof, first sentence: 'R^if_*F is by definition the ith cohomology sheaf of the complex f_*I^0 -> f_*I^1 -> ...'

proof.text: *The presheaf cohomology of $\mathcal K^\bullet$ is $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}$.* Let $\iota:\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)\to\textit{PAb}(\mathcal D)$ be the inclusion into abelian presheaves. $\textit{PAb}(\mathcal D)$ is abelian and every evaluation $\mathrm{ev}_V$ is exact [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-presheaves-evaluation-exact], so by [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] applied to $\mathrm{ev}_V$ the $q$-th cohomology presheaf $\mathcal Q^q=H^q(\iota\mathcal K^\bullet)$ of $\iota\mathcal K^\bullet$ has $\mathcal Q^q(V)=H^q(\mathcal K^\bullet(V))=\ker(\mathcal I^q(u(V))\to\mathcal I^{q+1}(u(V)))/\operatorname{im}(\mathcal I^{q-1}(u(V))\to\mathcal I^q(u(V)))$, compatibly with the projections from cycles; for $V'\to V$ the restriction of $\mathcal Q^q$ is induced by the restriction of $\mathcal K^\bullet$, i.e. by $\mathcal I^\bullet(u(V))\to\mathcal I^\bullet(u(V'))$ (naturality of these identifications in $V$). This is exactly the presheaf $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}$ of the statement, with the same restriction maps: $\mathcal Q^q=\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images, line 747), proof: 'this is obviously equal to Ker(I^i(u(V)) -> I^{i+1}(u(V)))/Im(...) which is equal to H^i(u(V), F)'

proof.text: *The canonical map $\theta$.* Write $Z^q(-)=\ker d^q$ and $\pi:Z^q(\mathcal K^\bullet)\to\mathcal H^q(\mathcal K^\bullet)$ for the projection in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal D)$, and $p:Z^q(\iota\mathcal K^\bullet)\to\mathcal Q^q$ for the projection in $\textit{PAb}(\mathcal D)$. Since $\iota$ preserves kernels [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact] (1), $Z^q(\iota\mathcal K^\bullet)=\iota Z^q(\mathcal K^\bullet)$. The map $\iota\pi$ vanishes on the image of $\iota\mathcal K^{q-1}\to Z^q(\iota\mathcal K^\bullet)$ (it is $\iota$ of a zero map), so it factors uniquely as $\iota\pi=\theta\circ p$ with $\theta:\mathcal Q^q\to\iota\mathcal H^q(\mathcal K^\bullet)=\iota R^qf_*\mathcal F$. Sectionwise (step 2) $\theta_V$ sends the class of a cocycle $s\in\mathcal I^q(u(V))=(f_*\mathcal I^q)(V)$ to $\pi_V(s)$, the section of the cohomology sheaf it defines: $\theta$ is the canonical map $\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}\to R^qf_*\mathcal F$ of the statement.

source.place: Lemma Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images, line 747), proof (the map from the presheaf of the proof to the cohomology sheaf, left implicit there)

proof.text: *Sheafifying: $\theta$ induces an isomorphism $(\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F})^\#\cong R^qf_*\mathcal F$.* Let $\#$ be sheafification, left adjoint to $\iota$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], with counit $\varepsilon:\#\iota\to\mathrm{id}$, an isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-finite-limits-objectwise] (3). Let $\theta^\flat=\varepsilon_{\mathcal H^q(\mathcal K^\bullet)}\circ\#\theta:(\mathcal Q^q)^\#\to\mathcal H^q(\mathcal K^\bullet)$ be the adjunct of $\theta$, i.e. the unique morphism with $\iota\theta^\flat\circ\eta=\theta$ for the unit $\eta:\mathcal Q^q\to\iota(\mathcal Q^q)^\#$. Since $\#$ is exact [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact] (2), [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] applied to $\#$ gives an isomorphism $c:\mathcal H^q(\#\iota\mathcal K^\bullet)\to\#\mathcal Q^q$ with $c\circ\pi_{\#\iota\mathcal K}=\#p$ under $Z^q(\#\iota\mathcal K^\bullet)=\#Z^q(\iota\mathcal K^\bullet)$, and $\varepsilon_{\mathcal K^\bullet}:\#\iota\mathcal K^\bullet\to\mathcal K^\bullet$ is an isomorphism of complexes (naturality of $\varepsilon$), so $\mathcal H^q(\varepsilon_{\mathcal K})\circ c^{-1}:\#\mathcal Q^q\to\mathcal H^q(\mathcal K^\bullet)$ is an isomorphism. It equals $\theta^\flat$: both are determined by their composite with $\#p$, which is an epimorphism ($p$ is one and $\#$ is exact). Now $\theta^\flat\circ\#p=\varepsilon_{\mathcal H^q}\circ\#(\iota\pi)=\pi\circ\varepsilon_{Z^q(\mathcal K)}$ by step 3 and naturality of $\varepsilon$; and $\mathcal H^q(\varepsilon_{\mathcal K})\circ c^{-1}\circ\#p=\mathcal H^q(\varepsilon_{\mathcal K})\circ\pi_{\#\iota\mathcal K}=\pi\circ Z^q(\varepsilon_{\mathcal K})=\pi\circ\varepsilon_{Z^q(\mathcal K)}$, the last equality because the inclusion $Z^q(\mathcal K)\to\mathcal K^q$ is a monomorphism and $\varepsilon$ is natural with respect to it. Hence $\theta^\flat$ is an isomorphism: $\theta=\iota\theta^\flat\circ\eta$ identifies $R^qf_*\mathcal F$ with $(\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F})^\#$ (step 2: $\mathcal Q^q=\mathcal P^q_{\mathcal F}$).

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks Cohomology on Sites Lemma 072W (sites-cohomology.tex line 747, tag verified in tags/tags) for O = Z and against the citer lem-weil-pbc-gabber-strict-henselian-zariski-comparison step 1, which uses exactly R^q eps_* F = (P^q)^# and the vanishing clause; statement kept. Not a Mathlib leaf: Mathlib has the pushforward of sheaves and Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf but no right derived functors of pushforward and no sheafified-homology comparison (LeanSearch, LeanFinder, Loogle, grep recorded). Proof split in five steps following the proof of 072W: (1) f_* left exact additive, injective resolution, R^q f_* F = H^q(f_*I); (2) presheaf cohomology of f_*I is P^q, via sectionwise exactness of evaluation; (3) construction of the canonical map theta from the left exactness of the inclusion iota; (4) sheafification is exact and its counit is an isomorphism, so H^q(f_*I) = (P^q)^# and the adjunct of theta is this isomorphism (written out: the source's 'by definition of the abelian category structure'); (5) vanishing. All cited nodes exist (Mathlib leaves except def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, same unit); no new nodes.
